annotations.title: Set a property of a node's resource

description:
Set a property inside a resource a node holds, such as a collision shape's size or a material's albedo_color, and save the scene. The resource must exist first: assign it with summer_set_prop.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/set-resource-property"}

resourceProperty.description: Resource property on the node, e.g. 'shape', 'mesh', 'material_override'

value.description: Value in Summer Engine variant-string format

name: summer_set_resource_property
